note: World-space colliders generated from level.json shapes. Godot: BoxShape3D / CylinderShape3D / ConvexPolygonShape3D / HeightMapShape3D (cell size = 'cell'). Hazards are areas (Area3D), not solid. Triggers (level exits) are areas too.

triggers.note: walking into the black at the end of the exit hallway loads the next level (Construct Error: handle in the level_exit trigger)

entrances.note: arrival: move the car node from rest_position + start_offset_y down to rest_position over duration_s with the player standing on it (Godot: apply_mobile.gd play_arrival). Its colliders are exported at the rest position.

gates.note: Construct Error: a StaticBody3D blocker stands here while closed (apply_mobile.gd); call open_gate(id) when the encounter's last wave is cleared - the beams fade out, the blocker goes, signal gate_opened(id).

encounters.notes: Stage 59: the player must clear three waves in the slime hall; the last kill opens the laser gate into the Works (Construct Error spawns / counts the enemies)

terminals.note: use it (interact) within radius: opens the gates in 'activates'

risers.note: pads start under the liquid; they surge up in order when a player enters the trigger sphere
the platform starts under the liquid; it surges up when a player enters the trigger sphere

winds.note: force = push along dir (x strength), lift while airborne; inside the cone only

pickups.note: live once the riser is up: pickup_reached(id, item)
